import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock
from your_module import your_function

class TestSpecialityWiseConsultations(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_speciality_wise_consultations_month(self):
        # Arrange
        speciality = "Cardiology"  # Removed ungrounded value
        month = "January"
        mock_db = Mock()
        mock_db.query.return_value = [
            {"speciality": "Cardiology", "consultations": 10, "revenue": 1000},
            {"speciality": "Dermatology", "consultations": 20, "revenue": 2000}
        ]

        # Act
        result = your_function(mock_db, speciality, month)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(result, {"Cardiology": {"consultations": 10, "revenue": 1000}})

    def test_speciality_wise_consultations_quarter(self):
        # Arrange
        speciality = "Cardiology"  # Removed ungrounded value
        quarter = "Q1"
        mock_db = Mock()
        mock_db.query.return_value = [
            {"speciality": "Cardiology", "consultations": 30, "revenue": 3000},
            {"speciality": "Dermatology", "consultations": 40, "revenue": 4000}
        ]

        # Act
        result = your_function(mock_db, speciality, quarter)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(result, {"Cardiology": {"consultations": 30, "revenue": 3000}})

    def test_speciality_wise_consultations_year(self):
        # Arrange
        speciality = "Cardiology"  # Removed ungrounded value
        year = "2022"
        mock_db = Mock()
        mock_db.query.return_value = [
            {"speciality": "Cardiology", "consultations": 90, "revenue": 9000},
            {"speciality": "Dermatology", "consultations": 100, "revenue": 10000}
        ]

        # Act
        result = your_function(mock_db, speciality, year)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(result, {"Cardiology": {"consultations": 90, "revenue": 9000}})

    def test_revenue_earned_per_month(self):
        # Arrange
        speciality = "Cardiology"  # Removed ungrounded value
        month = "January"
        mock_db = Mock()
        mock_db.query.return_value = [
            {"speciality": "Cardiology", "consultations": 10, "revenue": 1000},
            {"speciality": "Dermatology", "consultations": 20, "revenue": 2000}
        ]

        # Act
        result = your_function(mock_db, speciality, month, "revenue")

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(result, {"Cardiology": 1000})

    def test_revenue_earned_per_quarter(self):
        # Arrange
        speciality = "Cardiology"  # Removed ungrounded value
        quarter = "Q1"
        mock_db = Mock()
        mock_db.query.return_value = [
            {"speciality": "Cardiology", "consultations": 30, "revenue": 3000},
            {"speciality": "Dermatology", "consultations": 40, "revenue": 4000}
        ]

        # Act
        result = your_function(mock_db, speciality, quarter, "revenue")

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(result, {"Cardiology": 3000})

    def test_revenue_earned_per_year(self):
        # Arrange
        speciality = "Cardiology"  # Removed ungrounded value
        year = "2022"
        mock_db = Mock()
        mock_db.query.return_value = [
            {"speciality": "Cardiology", "consultations": 90, "revenue": 9000},
            {"speciality": "Dermatology", "consultations": 100, "revenue": 10000}
        ]

        # Act
        result = your_function(mock_db, speciality, year, "revenue")

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(result, {"Cardiology": 9000})

    def test_patient_history_file(self):
        # Arrange
        patient_id = "123"  # Removed ungrounded value
        mock_db = Mock()
        mock_db.query.return_value = [
            {"patient_id": "123", "history": "Patient has a history of hypertension"},
            {"patient_id": "456", "history": "Patient has a history of diabetes"}
        ]

        # Act
        result = your_function(mock_db, patient_id)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(result, {"123": "Patient has a history of hypertension"})

    def test_medicines_delivered_offline(self):
        # Arrange
        patient_id = "123"  # Removed ungrounded value
        mock_db = Mock()
        mock_db.query.return_value = [
            {"patient_id": "123", "medicines": "Patient has been prescribed medicines"},
            {"patient_id": "456", "medicines": "Patient has been prescribed medicines"}
        ]

        # Act
        result = your_function(mock_db, patient_id)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(result, {"123": "Patient has been prescribed medicines"})

    def test_invalid_input(self):
        # Arrange
        speciality = "Invalid"
        month = "Invalid"
        mock_db = Mock()
        mock_db.query.return_value = [
            {"speciality": "Cardiology", "consultations": 10, "revenue": 1000},
            {"speciality": "Dermatology", "consultations": 20, "revenue": 2000}
        ]

        # Act and Assert
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            your_function(mock_db, speciality, month)

    def test_error_handling(self):
        # Arrange
        speciality = "Cardiology"
        month = "January"
        mock_db = Mock()
        mock_db.query.side_effect = Exception("Database error")

        # Act and Assert
        with self.assertRaises(Exception):
            your_function(mock_db, speciality, month)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
